segments.summary: Reviewed Planning Wizard topic controls and PRD Builder annotation/answer controls. The common wiring, receipt, accessibility, and fixture contract is explicit, while command-specific payload/result and failure/concurrency semantics remain unspecified.

Reviewed PRD answer, approval, conflict, reopen, import, project-add, and legacy Chain Wizard routing. Named approval events and the retirement boundary are explicit; approval atomicity and source-import trust/lifecycle rules are not.

Reviewed GitHub/local project creation, project open, remote reconnect, runtime abort, and runtime approve. GitHub preflight authority is strong, but remote-create reconciliation, runtime action authority/races, and reconnect lifecycle remain open.
Reviewed runtime decline, operational detail routes, and replan. Decline has no domain outcome, diagnostic views lack data/privacy/scale contracts, and replan lacks versioning and failure recovery.

Reviewed restore/retry, prerequisite resume, immediate retry, skip, fresh-attempt, and remote-cache eviction controls. Multiple compound runtime effects lack atomicity; several command names are not supported by their declared effects; cache eviction scope and outcomes are undefined.
